messages:
ashley: Quick heads-up — trying to land PR #19833 (replication backpressure tweak). Need quick approvals to avoid hitting tonight's 02:00-03:00 UTC nightly blackout. CI queue is long so timing matters.

devin: what's blocking? tests flaky or queue backlog?

ashley: matrix looks green except the windows lane is stuck in the queue (job `windows/scale-tests`). one rerun timed out earlier.

sam: i can take eyes now. is a rebase required?

ashley: small rebase because of the schema patch on main. rebase will trigger full CI run though.

taylor: if we land right before blackout we risk a merge spike. can we stagger?

devin: propose serializing merges with a 2–5m delay between items from the merge queue so CI doesn't spike.

ashley: plan: get approvals, rebase, then queue merges spaced 5m apart. will also push a canary to prod-2 after the merge to smoke test.

ci-bot: windows/scale-tests estimated wait time ~42m. rerun requested by @ashley.

ashley: pinging @sam @taylor for approvals — let me know quick if anything blocking.

sam: skimmed diffs, one tiny nit in comments (non-blocking). approving.

taylor: approved. :thumbsup: no blocking issues from infra side.

deploy-bot: Reminder: nightly blackout window 2026-03-18 02:00-03:00 UTC. Automated merges will pause during this window.

ashley: thanks — rebase now, will queue after CI passes and enforce 5m spacing. ping here if windows lane flakes again or if we need to delay past blackout.
